items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, I wrote some things, and Bob wrote some things, Holloway wrote some things – Roger Kellaway, rather, wrote some things. Everybody contributed something.

ctx.x: Were you writing for the band as well?
Yeah, I wrote some things, and Bob wrote some things, Holloway wrote some things – Roger Kellaway, rather, wrote some things. Everybody contributed something.
Who were some of the other personnel of that aggregation, besides Chris Woods?
